goal: At least 90 percent engineering execution accuracy, with five fixed actual executed projects
current_study_scope: Retrospective school construction contract cost only

project_analyzer.needed: Verified original plans, project scope, design revisions and measured geometry labels

quantity_estimator.needed: Measured BOQ quantities linked to drawings, units, revisions and final as-built quantities

cost_estimator.needed: This study evaluates only contract cost; full-engine acceptance additionally needs scope-matched quantities, dated supply/installed quotes and independent actual final costs

schedule_optimizer.needed: Original approved activity network, calendars, baseline dates and actual start/finish dates for the same projects

risk_analyzer.needed: Time-stamped pre-outcome inputs and independently adjudicated risk outcomes with sufficient minority events

quality_inspector.needed: Project-linked inspection records, defect labels and outcomes, including acceptable and failed work

supplier_intelligence.needed: Dated orders, quoted terms, promised/actual deliveries, quality and payment outcomes linked to supplier and project

next_evaluation_policy: Do not tune on exposed 2025 outcomes then label them fresh. Select new recipes on development data, then freeze a genuinely separate cohort with project-linked evidence for each claimed engine.
